tool.name: Refl1D
tool.command: touch $output && ls /SNS/users/\$GALAXY_TOOL_USER > /dev/null && cd /SNS/users/\$GALAXY_TOOL_USER && pixi run --manifest-path /opt/run/pyproject.toml supervisord > >(tee -a $output) 2> >(tee -a $output >&2)
tool.help:
Starts Refl1D interactive tool.
1-D reflectometry allows material scientists to understand the structure of thin films, providing composition and density information as a function of depth. With polarized neutron measurements, scientists can study the sub-surface structure of magnetic samples. The Refl1D modeling program supports a mixture of slabs, freeform and specialized layer types such as models for the density distribution of polymer brushes. More information on Refl1D can be found at https://refl1d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/.
